title: Use of Probiotic Yogurt in the Treatment of Acute Diarrhea in Children
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the effect of probiotic yogurt in acute watery diarrhea in children. The investigators will compare the effect of two different probiotics products.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All acute diarrhea

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe malnourishment
* Severe dehydration
* Systemic infections
